gaps.description: DAIR.AI is a selective editorial source, so papers not chosen by its curators are outside this retrieval.
The upstream repository declares no license. MOZAK records titles, links and provenance only; DAIR.AI prose summaries are not retained.

steps: Resolve the official repository to an exact commit
Fetch the requested year file at that immutable commit
Use curator prose transiently for cluster matching
Record only paper titles, links, issue labels and provenance
